name: Uncertainty-aware NeRF
definition: A NeRF variant that separately predicts uncertainties for rendered color and depth images to reveal data reliability at the pixel level, addressing artifacts and redundancy in synthetic data for Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR).
summary: Uncertainty-aware NeRF is a neural radiance field variant that predicts Gaussian distributions for color and depth, quantifying aleatoric uncertainty to reveal data reliability at the pixel level.
